description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Regulation made to amend the Regulation "D'' - Reserve Requirements by the deletion of the figure '6 per centum' and by substitution of '7.5 per centum' in Regulation 2(i), with effect from 16.01.2016
categorisation: This gazette content contains regulations made by the Monetary Board of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka under the Monetary Law Act, specifically amending reserve requirements. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and amendments to financial regulations.
